note: Skin catalogue for the Spinback Skin Store page. The page is finished and reads this file: every entry in skins[] is rendered with search, category filters, sorting and a detail sheet, and an entry only needs a name. Add entries as name, category, and optionally item, rarity, image (any URL or /media/... path), released and id. Nothing here is generated or guessed - an empty list is shown honestly as 'not published yet'.

fields.name: the skin name shown on the card (required)
fields.category: weapon, clothing, building, decor, tool, vehicle ... used for the filter chips
fields.item: the in-game item the skin applies to
fields.rarity: short label shown in the corner of the card, e.g. Common or Rare
fields.released: YYYY-MM-DD, used by the newest-first sort
fields.id: catalog or store id, shown in the detail sheet
